name: Laravel + MySQL (Compose)
postCreateCommand: set -e; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y unzip zlib1g-dev libzip-dev libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libfreetype6-dev; sudo bash -lc 'export PHP_INI_DIR=/usr/local/etc/php; docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg; docker-php-ext-install -j$(nproc) gd zip calendar; docker-php-ext-enable gd zip calendar'; echo 'xdebug.mode=off' | sudo tee /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/99-xdebug-cli.ini >/dev/null; php -m | grep -E 'calendar|gd|zip'
